item.title: Attorney General Ellison sues to block latest Trump Administration effort to undermine Affordable Care Act, drive up Americans’ health insurance costs

Joins coalition of 21 states in suing over new federal rule that reinstates provisions another federal court blocked, adds new harmful changes related to catastrophic health plans that will drive up consumers’ out-of-pocket costs and make insurance harder to get
